Caveat: the page is an India customs mirror and the remaining 91 records are not visible on the free view, so the export share of the 96 cannot be quantified; the buyer-side counterparties listed (DASHMESH INTERNATIONAL TRADING FZE, PNP WAREHOUSING SDN BHD, OMAN UNITED AGENCIES LLC, SKY COEM INTERNATIONAL LIMITED) are consistent with outbound trade lanes but are not individually dated records.

Not evidence of absence — simply not retrieved.
note: Import-side activity is heavy and well documented (Lighthouse Drinks Ltd / Ireland whisky under HS 22083019, William Grant & Sons, ASK Co Ltd Japan barrels under HS 44160010, all into Tuglakabad/Kanakpura/Gari Harsaru ICDs, latest 2026-02-17), i.e. the company is primarily an importer/bottler for the Indian market. One genuine export consignment to UAE (B/L 9366812, 2026-02-04, HS 22083013) is on record, so export_status = confirmed, but on a single visible row — the free view does not let me count how many of the 96 records are outbound. Domestic supply: no trace found in this session, but the retrieval failure is on my side, not the company's — treat as unknown, not as 'no supplies'.
